description: This file defines a React component for user notification settings in Mattermost, including handling notification preferences, keywords, auto-responder, and related UI sections.

classes.name: NotificationsTab
classes.description: React component for managing user notification settings, including preferences for desktop, mobile, email, keywords, comments, and auto-responder.
